Structural Rebar · Revit Add-in

Additional Rebar from CAD

Turn CAD rebar details into modeled reinforcement.

Read reinforcement linework and annotations from a selected AutoCAD layer and generate additional top or bottom Revit bars for flat slabs and rafts.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Watch Demo
Key features

Use the drawing you already have

Additional reinforcement can be spread across dozens of zones. Use the drawing as the input for bar layout and spacing, then review the Revit bars against the source detail.

  • 01

    Extracts rebar data from CAD linework and annotations

    no re-drawing required

  • 02

    Places all bottom additional steel across an entire slab or raft in one operation

  • 03

    Places all top additional steel across an entire slab or raft in one operation

  • 04

    Works for raft slabs and conventional concrete flat slabs

  • 05

    Automatically spaces and distributes bars based on dimensions in the CAD drawing

  • 06

    Select the CAD layer that contains the reinforcement geometry and annotations.

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Additional Rebar from CAD

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Additional Rebar from CAD
Read the reinforcement detailManual Revit workflowInspect each zone and transfer bar geometry and spacing into Revit.With Additional Rebar from CADSelect the CAD layer that carries the reinforcement linework and annotations.
Model the additional barsManual Revit workflowPlace and distribute the bars for each zone individually.With Additional Rebar from CADGenerate the top or bottom additional bars from the selected detail.
Verify the resultManual Revit workflowCompare the manually modeled bars with the detail drawing.With Additional Rebar from CADCompare generated bars with the drawing before issuing the model.
Illustrative time comparison

Modeling additional rebar in a flat slab or raft

Starts from an imported drawing with usable reinforcement layers and annotations, and a modeled concrete host. Includes checking bar placement against the drawing. These are planning estimates. Actual times depend on the model and setup.

One layer · 10 zones

Manual in Revit

35–60 min

Model and review the bars across ten additional reinforcement zones.

Additional Rebar from CAD

2–3 min

Select the layer, generate the bars, and review the ten zones.

32–58 min estimated savings

Top and bottom · 40 zones total

Manual in Revit

120–210 min

Rebuild both layers and review the bar distributions by zone.

Additional Rebar from CAD

4–8 min

Generate each layer in turn and spot-check the bars against the source detail.

112–206 min estimated savings
